note: Operational record for the paired-arm run, append-only from Phase 2. Deliberately SEPARATE from evals/paired_arm_replication.json: that file's prereg is frozen at Phase 1 and cannot absorb values measured afterwards. Nothing here constrains what the experiment means -- only how it is executed. Concurrency, per-pair cost, and the session cap are measurements, not hypotheses.

pilot.purpose: Phase 2 cost pilot: 4 dispatch slots on 2 of the 3 EXCLUDED twin_defective scenarios. Comparable material, formally outside the corpus, so no study output is inspected before the study is registered. Establishes (1) both material bundles produce parseable verdict JSON, (2) the reconcile -> dispatch -> verify -> commit -> RESUME loop works including a deliberately interrupted pair, (3) measured per-pair and grading cost, (4) the host's actual usable agent concurrency.
pilot.outside_the_study: These scenario ids are NOT in prereg.study_scenarios, so validate-paired-arm.py rejects them in the study record by construction. Pilot attempts live here and are validated with the same validate_attempt() code path via its `scenarios` parameter -- the pilot tests the shipped validator rather than a parallel implementation of it.

findings.what: Both arms were scored candidate_output_status='malformed' on first grading. The outputs were well-formed: prose then a single trailing fenced json verdict block, exactly as the frozen task template asks. grade_structural._extract_json's fence regex accepted only an untagged or `json` opening fence, so a reviewer that quoted a ```sql or ```swift block in its reasoning broke fence PAIRING -- the pattern opened on that block's CLOSING fence, swallowed the prose up to the ```json opener, and left the real verdict block unopened.
findings.why_it_matters: This is the pilot doing its job. Run blind across 110 study slots it would have produced a silent, arm-correlated bias: quoting the code under review is exactly the behaviour a rubric-following reviewer is more likely to exhibit, so the arm with the lens would have been scored malformed more often -- a measurement artifact pointing the WRONG WAY, against the skill, and invisible in the aggregate.
findings.fix: grade_structural._extract_json now accepts any language tag; scripts/paired_arm_grade.py gained the same fix for grader replies. RED regression case added to _grade_structural_selftest.py. Both pilot attempts re-graded from their committed, immutable outputs -- no re-dispatch, the model output never changed.
